title: On the release build the notice and column pill end on the seventh day
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the release build of the release that ships Technician Toggle, and know its scheduled release date.
  • Set your computer's clock to 06:58 UTC on the seventh day after that release date.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Set your computer's clock to 07:01 UTC on the same day.
  2. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The notice and the "New" pill on the Technician column header are gone.

Step 2:

  • Neither the notice nor the pill shows (if they still show, the build still carries the 31 Dec 2026 placeholder date).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S4-R5: “The notice cannot be closed. It disappears for everyone at the same moment as the "New" pill (S1-R2), including in a page that is already open.”
  • S4-R3: “A "New" pill sits at the top right of the "Technician" column header, touching the end of the word and inside the column, clear of the Billable header. It follows the same end date as S1-R2.”

From: Jira tickets under epic SV-11788 (saved 2 Nov 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11788-tickets-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Jira SV-12008: “When the release that ships Technician Toggle is scheduled, set the end date of its "New" pills (on the Technician toggle in the New and Edit Staff Member windows, and on the staff list's Technician column header) and of the staff list notice to 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release date.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "1 Staff list", picture "Notice and Technician column" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p1-02-after-notice-and-technician-column.png

The design's own words:

  • “Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."”
  • “No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.”
  • “Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).”
  • “"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”

The after-the-end-date state is not drawn (register TT-N17).

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the end date is set only when the release is scheduled; run on the release build before release day
